newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar settles sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar settles sharply lower.

text.p: White sugar futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday in what traders said was a downward correction following last week's rally.
August finished $4.50 lower at $320.50 and dominated volume at 3,991 lots. October was off $1.40 at $315.30.
Supportive trade buying dragged nearby white sugar futures back from their earlier lows, market sources said.
August had hit a session low of $319.70 before bouncing higher.
Earlier, it effectively wiped out this month's gains after gapping at the open and coming under commission house and broker selling.
Last week's fund-inspired rally, which pushed August to a high of $330.80, had been overdone and the market naturally looked for a downward correction, traders said.
